newsitem.title: USA: Core Labs in talks to buy Scott Pickford.
newsitem.headline: Core Labs in talks to buy Scott Pickford.

text.p: Core Laboratories NV said it is in talks to buy Scott Pickford Plc for $0.89 a share in cash.
Scott Pickford, which provides gas reservoir management and geoscience services, had annual revenues of $14 million for the year ended March 31, 1996.
Scott Pickford's board will recommend the acquisition to the company's shareholders, according to Core Laboratories.
Core Laboratories did not say what the acquisition would potentially add to its revenues or earnings. Officials there were not immediately available to comment.
